messages:
tim: quick Q — trying to trace missing spans for a customer's VPC (prod-vpc-12). Where do I look for their OTLP ingestion and the Grafana instance they use? Also worried logs might not be forwarded. Any quick smoke checks?

maria: short answer: Grafana link + prom remote write -> we host remote write for customer clusters under `rw-prod-<cust-id>`. Check the customer dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd123/customer-vpc-overview (use the timepicker for the last 30m). Runbook: https://wiki.redwood/internal/vpc-onboard — section "Observability checks" has step-by-step.

sanjay: OTEL side checks: on the customer's collector pod do `kubectl -n observability logs deploy/otel-collector -c otel-collector | grep Exporter` to see exporter statuses. On our ingestion Prometheus, try: `sum(rate(otel_exporter_sent_spans_total{customer=\"prod-vpc-12\"}[5m]))` — >0 means traces are leaving their collector.

alex: For logs, determine which forwarder they use. If promtail: `kubectl -n logging logs ds/promtail | tail -n 200` on the gateway node to spot send errors. If fluent-bit, check `/var/log/fluent-bit.log`. We also have a Loki pipeline dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/efgh456/promtail-pipelines (panels: queue_size, send_errors).

tim: thanks — any quick command to validate remote-write is flowing? don't want to open full runbook.

maria: quick prom query you can paste into Explore: `rate(prometheus_remote_storage_samples_total{job=\"remote_write\", customer=\"prod-vpc-12\"}[1m])` — if >0 samples/sec you're good. For traces in GrafanaTempo: check `sum(tempo_spans_ingested_total{customer=\"prod-vpc-12\"})` or the otel collector metrics mentioned above.

infra-bot: automated check for prod-vpc-12: prom_remote_write_last_success=2026-02-16T18:20:01Z, otel_ingest_rate=12.4/s, loki_forwarder_errors_last_5m=0 :white_check_mark:

sanjay: if you still see gaps after those checks, LMK and I'll pull the collector logs + forwarding pipeline (can also grep for `failed to export` or `auth` errors). Also check customer secret `secret/vpc-123` for rotated tokens.

tim: perfect — I'll run the two prom queries and ping back. :thumbsup:
